item.title: Supreme Court blocks Trump-backed Missouri congressional map
item.description: The ruling is a defeat for Republicans seeking to give their party an edge in the midterm elections for control of the House. It means voters will face a different map than the one used in the primary elections.

item.title: The Pacific is churning with hurricanes. The Atlantic is quiet. Blame El Niño
item.description: The Pacific Ocean has had an unusual number of storms this year, while the Atlantic hasn't recorded a single full-blown hurricane. Scientists point to an exceptionally strong El Niño.
item.content:encoded:
The Pacific Ocean has had an unusual number of storms this year, while the Atlantic hasn't recorded a single full-blown hurricane. Scientists point to an exceptionally strong El Niño.

(Image credit: NOAA via AP)

item.title: The Supreme Court revives a controversial data system for citizenship checks
item.description: The Supreme Court is allowing use of a data system that Trump officials overhauled. The system has erroneously flagged U.S. citizens and a lower court found it violated federal privacy protections.

item.title: Hurricane Nolo, a zig-zagging storm, threatens Hawaii with flooding rains
item.description: Nolo will slow down as it nears Hawaii's Big Island and is expected to become a major hurricane this weekend, bringing torrential rain to areas that have been flooded by big storms this summer.
